chapter: Later bands, Joe Turner and records
title: Abby's small band near the French Market
summary: Playing with Abby around Decatur Street and the Filipino hall.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Around the French market. French market? Andrews. That's when they have been pretty kind of regular there. Andrews.
I think it's on Managos Street, I believe. Yeah.
Decatur Street was a big street.
Look, I'm going to tell you where it was. It's nothing but Filipinos around in that area. Yeah. What street that is?
Yeah. Nothing but... They got a Filipino hall not too far from there. Mm-hmm. We even played in the hall with Abby.
How many pieces did you use with Abby?
Abby never used over four pieces.
Yeah. Who was playing with them? Me.
Abby. And Abby. Teddy Johnson. Mm-hmm. And that's all. New trumpet? Some street pieces. They used to use Leroy. Leroy Thompson. Yeah. That was his man. Mm-hmm.
